answer: A refundable stake bond makes fake identities expensive: every agent locks collateral before it can earn, so spawning a thousand Sybils means locking a thousand bonds. Honest work earns the bond back with yield, while detected fraud slashes it — the summit of profit sits far above the nadir of a slashed balance. An ivory-tower reputation score alone cannot do this, because words are free; only capital at risk turns identity into a cost an attacker must pay per fake.
